query: Please implement a web application that dynamically generates forms. The application should be able to generate different types of forms based on configuration data, including text input boxes, select boxes, checkboxes, and more. Users should be able to customize the structure and content of the form through configuration data and preview the generated form in real-time. The application should also have form validation and submission functionality, checking whether user input data is valid and submitting it to the server. Apply ivory as the background; style all components with chocolate.
